test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a tax subsumed under GST in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Income Tax.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Income Tax is not a tax subsumed under GST in India.**
 
• **GST refers to Goods and Services Tax. **It is an **indirect tax **which has replaced many indirect taxes in India such as the excise duty, VAT, services tax, etc.
 
• The Goods and Service Tax Act **was passed in the Indian Parliament on 29th March 2017 and came in result on 1st July 2017.**
 
• The notable dissimilarity among GST and Income Tax is that the GST is impose on the consumption of the goods and services, whereas income tax is impose on the income of a person. In a way, GST is an indirect tax, whereas income tax is a direct tax.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Service tax is **a tax imposed by the government on service providers on sure service transactions, but is actually support by the customers**. 
 
• 
 **Additional Customs Duty (CVD)This duty, commonly refers to as countervailing duty (CVD),** is imposed** on imported goods in terms of section 3 of the ****Customs Tariff Act, 1975**** and is equal to the Central Excise duty imposable on the like goods if produced or manufactured in India**.
 
 
• 
 An **excise or excise tax (sometimes called an excise duty) is ******a kind of tax charged on goods produced within the country**.**
